calls.statement:
SELECT m.home_store_id, count(*) AS rows_, count(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS members, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.is_current THEN m.member_id END) AS current_members, min(m.join_date) AS min_join, max(m.join_date) AS max_join, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.is_current AND m.marketing_consent THEN m.member_id END) AS consenting
FROM dim_member m WHERE m.home_store_id IN (115,116,117,136,900,999) OR m.home_store_id NOT IN (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH cur AS (SELECT member_id, home_store_id FROM dim_member WHERE is_current),
tamp AS (SELECT DISTINCT store_id FROM dim_store WHERE city = 'Tampere' AND store_id < 900)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM cur) AS current_rows, (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM cur) AS current_distinct,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE valid_to='9999-12-31') AS open_rows,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM cur c JOIN tamp t ON t.store_id=c.home_store_id) AS tampere_rows,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT c.member_id) FROM cur c JOIN tamp t ON t.store_id=c.home_store_id) AS tampere_members,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member m JOIN tamp t ON t.store_id=m.home_store_id) AS ever_tampere,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_member_updates) AS stg_rows

calls.statement:
SELECT count(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS members_bought_in_tampere_stores, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.sale_date > DATE '2025-10-08' THEN m.member_id END) AS last_12m, max(f.sale_date) AS last_sale
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key AND s.city='Tampere' AND s.store_id<900
JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key
